subject: English
learningObjectives: Learn about the ecosystem of a banyan tree
Classic battle between Cobra and Mongoose
examples: Squirrels and birds in the tree
The grey mongoose vs black cobra
misconceptions: The mongoose is immune to snake venom (it is just very fast)

practiceExercises.question: Who were the two "uninvited" spectators of the fight?
practiceExercises.explanation: A myna and a jungle crow sat on a cactus to watch the battle.

flashcards.back: Older than the house, as old as the town

revisionNotes: Nature has its own laws of survival. The banyan tree is a world in itself.
commonMistakes: Thinking the crow survived the fight (it was bitten by the cobra)
